origin.description: Run code with a directory prefixed onto PATH.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run with the modified PATH.

origin.details: The default action is prefix. The check reads the first PATH entry.
origin.example:
dir.create("/tmp/withr-path-marker", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
before <- Sys.getenv("PATH")
first <- with_path(
  "/tmp/withr-path-marker",
  strsplit(Sys.getenv("PATH"), .Platform$path.sep)[[1]][1]
)
c(first, if (identical(Sys.getenv("PATH"), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Run code with a directory prefixed onto PATH.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run with the modified PATH.

translation.details: The default action is prefix. The check reads the first PATH entry. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

os.makedirs("/tmp/withr-path-marker", exist_ok=True)
before = os.environ.get("PATH", "")
first = with_path(
    "/tmp/withr-path-marker",
    lambda: os.environ["PATH"].split(os.pathsep)[0],
)
flag = "restored" if os.environ.get("PATH", "") == before else "open"
return [first, flag]
